# Abhishek (idcare19)

Abhishek, also known as idcare19, is a full-stack developer from India working remotely. He builds web apps, SaaS products and business websites with Next.js, React, TypeScript and Django, from interface to API to database. He is open to freelance projects and remote opportunities.

## Services

- Full-stack web application development
- SaaS product development from discovery to launch
- Next.js and React frontend development
- Django and Django REST API development
- Business websites, dashboards, integrations and performance improvements

## Technology

Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Django, Django REST Framework, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, Docker, Git, GitHub and Vercel.

## Contact

For freelance or remote work, use the contact form on the website or email personal@idcare19.me.
